purpose: §11.2 — decide the STT stack (and honestly report Hindi/Hinglish WER) from real recordings before shipping a voice model.
instructions: Run `npm run dev`, open http://localhost:5577/evaluation/voice/record.html (not the file directly — a file:// page cannot read phrases.json), allow the microphone, and read each phrase once, naturally.
Record in a normal room, not a silent booth — a quiet booth makes every recognizer look good and tells you nothing.
One take per phrase is enough. If you fluff a line, re-record that one.
Then, for each clip, play it into the portfolio's voice mode and copy the transcript the panel shows into transcripts.json.

what_the_numbers_decide.under_20_percent_wer: the tier's STT is usable; ship it and say so in the docs
what_the_numbers_decide.20_to_35_percent_wer: usable with the transcript shown and editable (already built), but say the number out loud in the README
what_the_numbers_decide.over_35_percent_wer: §11.2's honesty rule: voice input for that language is offered only through the browser's own engine (S0) if available, and the UI says voice works best in English — never pretend

phrases.text: What is your CGPA?
phrases.probes: the single most common recruiter question; the number is the hard part

phrases.text: Tell me about your projects.
Which databases have you worked with?
How can I contact you?
What is your CGPA out of ten?
Did you intern at Google?
phrases.probes: hallucination bait — the answer must decline, and the transcript must not invent a company

phrases.text: What certifications do you have?
Explain the Volunteer OS architecture.
phrases.probes: a proper noun (the codename) — the class of word recognizers mangle

phrases.text: Are you available for a full-time role?
Compare MongoDB and MySQL in your projects.
phrases.probes: two technology names in one sentence

phrases.text: आपका सीजीपीए कितना है?
आपने कौन से प्रोजेक्ट बनाए हैं?
phrases.probes: the projects question, with the English loan word 'प्रोजेक्ट'

phrases.text: आपकी पढ़ाई कहाँ से हुई है?
phrases.probes: education; the matra-heavy word पढ़ाई is a tokenizer trap too

phrases.text: क्या आपने किसी कंपनी में काम किया है?
आपका ईमेल पता क्या है?
आपको कौन सी तकनीकें आती हैं?
आपका सबसे अच्छा प्रोजेक्ट कौन सा है?
आपने कौन से सर्टिफिकेट लिए हैं?
क्या आप फुल टाइम के लिए उपलब्ध हैं?
आप गूगल में इंटर्नशिप करना चाहेंगे?
phrases.probes: a hypothetical that must not be answered as fact
